html:
If you are staying in Ho Chi Minh City and looking for a private car tour with a professional driver, Vietlook Travel offers a flexible and comfortable solution that allows you to explore the city at your own pace.

This private car service is ideal for travelers who prefer privacy, convenience, and the freedom to choose their own itinerary, without following fixed group tours or schedules.

Ho Chi Minh City Tour At Your Own Pace

Unlike standard city tours with fixed routes, our Ho Chi Minh City private car tour gives you complete control over your travel plan.

You can:

  • Choose your own starting time

  • Decide where to go and how long to stay at each place

  • Stop anytime for photos, coffee, shopping, or lunch

  • Adjust the itinerary during the trip based on your interests

This service is suitable for sightseeing, business meetings, shopping, or simply moving around the city comfortably.

Suggested Places to Visit in Ho Chi Minh City

With a private car, you may choose to visit:

  • Independence Palace

  • Notre Dame Cathedral

  • Central Post Office

  • War Remnants Museum

  • Ben Thanh Market

  • Saigon River area

  • Chinatown in District Five

  • Local coffee shops and shopping streets

The itinerary is fully customizable within your booked time.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced and polite local drivers

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Assistance with luggage if needed

Vehicle options include sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles to suit different group sizes.
